notes: Every AFI_SOCIO party gets one lossless relationship row, including parties with three null assignments.
Employee identity is ID_EMPRESA:ID_PERSONA and resolves through m_staff.external_id.
The three Arissto roles are preserved independently and none is projected into Fineract's native loan-officer field.
The service never changes m_staff.is_loan_officer or employee active status.
The extension is authoritative because valid Arissto assignments can cross Fineract office hierarchies.
Native m_client.staff_id and m_client.gestor_id remain target-owned and are not changed by this service.
The service never deletes clients, staff, or relationship rows.
